body.name: alicedhaha/moonrcinspect
body.description: MoonBit-native SPEF parasitic RC network parser, analyzer, auditor, and visualizer

matched_packages.name: alicedhaha/moonrcinspect
matched_packages.summary:
MoonRCInspect 是一个 MoonBit 原生的 SPEF 寄生 RC 网络解析、分析、审计与可视化工具。它提供网络统计、连通性检查、Elmore 延迟、数据质量审计、路径分析、电阻矩阵、耦合分析和 RC 降阶等特性，支持 JSON、Graphviz DOT、CSV、SARIF 等多种输出格式。

Keywords: SPEF, RC网络, 寄生参数, 解析, 分析, 审计, 可视化, Elmore延迟, 路径分析, 电阻矩阵, 耦合电容, 降阶, CLI, MoonBit, 数据质量

matched_packages.name: alicedhaha/moonrcinspect/src/analyzer
matched_packages.summary:
This package analyzes RC networks: it produces design-level metrics, per-net metrics with anomaly detection, and computes Elmore delay when the net forms a connected single-driver tree, returning an explicit status otherwise.

Keywords: RC network, analyzer, DesignMetrics, NetMetrics, Elmore delay, ElmoreResult, ElmoreStatus, NodeDelay, net analysis, anomaly detection, complexity score, RC网络, 延时分析, 电路分析

matched_packages.name: alicedhaha/moonrcinspect/src/audit
matched_packages.summary:
This package provides auditing utilities for RC networks, returning an AuditReport with diagnostics and pass/fail status, configurable by AuditConfig (strict mode, tolerance, complexity threshold). It supports running a default set of rules or a custom selection via audit_with_rules.

Keywords: audit, RCNetwork, AuditRule, AuditConfig, AuditReport, diagnostics, strict mode, capacitance tolerance, complexity threshold, audit_with_rules, default_rules, 审计, 规则
